ctaHeading: Ready to restore your heritage tiles?
aboutText: Tessellated Tiles specialises in the restoration and replication of heritage tiles across Adelaide, Melbourne and Sydney. With deep expertise in Victorian and Federation-era tessellated tiles, we help homeowners preserve the intricate craftsmanship and timeless beauty of Australia's architectural heritage. Our passionate team brings decades of knowledge to every project, from design consultation through to meticulous installation. We proudly serve heritage-rich suburbs including Unley, Norwood, Glenelg, Paddington and St Kilda.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of tessellated and heritage tile services covering design, procurement, installation and restoration. Our team works with homeowners and property managers across South Australia, New South Wales and Victoria to preserve and enhance period homes.

services.title: Design Consultation
services.desc: We help you select authentic tessellated tile patterns and colour schemes that match your heritage property's era and style.

services.title: Tessellated Tile Procurement
services.desc: We source genuine and reproduction heritage tiles from specialist suppliers across Australia for your project.

services.title: Tessellated Tile Installation
services.desc: Our skilled team precisely lays tessellated tiles to recreate stunning Victorian and Federation patterns in your home.

services.title: Restoration Service
services.desc: We restore damaged or deteriorated heritage tilework, preserving the original character and craftsmanship of your floors and walls.

services.title: Bullnose Steps & Verandah Edging
services.desc: We supply and install bullnose tiles for heritage verandah edges, steps and porches across Adelaide and Melbourne.

services.title: Heritage Floor Mosaic Repair
services.desc: We carefully repair and replace damaged mosaic sections in tessellated floors to maintain period accuracy.

reviews.text: The team at Tessellated Tiles did an incredible job restoring the tessellated entryway of our Unley villa. The design consultation was thorough and the installation was flawless. Our heritage floors look exactly as they did when the home was built in the 1890s.
reviews.name: Sarah Mitchell

reviews.text: We engaged Tessellated Tiles to install tessellated tiles in our Norwood cafe renovation. They sourced the perfect Federation-era pattern and handled procurement and installation seamlessly. Customers constantly comment on the beautiful heritage flooring.
reviews.name: James Kowalski

reviews.text: Tessellated Tiles restored the heritage verandah tiles at our Glenelg property. Their attention to detail was outstanding and they replaced all the damaged bullnose edging too. Professional and passionate about heritage preservation.
reviews.name: Catherine O'Brien
